points.name: settings.gnss.row_register
points.interpretation: The option row registers callback 0xc55e39d with filter 7 and the row index as event user data.

points.name: settings.gnss.radio_register
points.interpretation: The radio control registers the same callback, filter, and index.

points.name: settings.gnss.event_code
points.interpretation: The handler proceeds only for event code 7.

points.name: settings.gnss.event_data
points.interpretation: The low byte of user data is used as the selected index; only 0, 1 and 2 reach the persist.gnss_mode write.

points.name: settings.gnss.info_clear_flag
points.interpretation: Rows with index greater than 2 clear flag 2 on the row object.

evidence: The settings manifest registers the descriptor; create associates the row table with the stored list view. The first three rows register the same callback on the row and radio object; their index is passed as user data. The event handler checks code 7 and accepts low-byte indices 0, 1 or 2 before calling the persistent property setter. Destroy clears the list view.
scope: Only listed calls on this page. Other consumers and writers of persist.gnss_mode are not intercepted.
limitations: Changing the event data can change the saved GNSS mode; invalid values do not enter the setter branch. State slots are not thread synchronization. Device behavior and recovery are unverified.
